name: Male Weapon Mesh Patch
author: vkays
description: Registers WarHammerBetter and ScimitarSpecial in the male player composite, which ships with 88 model entries against the female composite's 90. No art is added: both GR2s ship and both composites already point at the same shared files under Models3D/Weapons/, so the gap is two entries in a registry rather than two missing meshes. Built by mods/male-weapon-mesh-patch/build.py from vanilla, so rerun it rather than editing the binary by hand.
